name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 3px solid #005fcc focus ring at 80% opacity with a 1px inner #ffff. It balances visibility for keyboard users with subtlety for sighted users, avoiding distraction while ensuring clarity. The trade-off is slightly reduced prominence compared to the 4px version, but it prevents visual clutter in dense interfaces. This matches WCAG’s 3:1 contrast requirement for focus indicators while keeping the ring from overpowering content.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring at 80% opacity still fails WCAG 2.2’s 3:1 contrast on light backgrounds—exposing users to legal risk and exclusion. Swap to a 3px solid #005fcc ring with 1px inner #fff at 100% opacity; it meets contrast, stays clean, and settles the debate.

name: Ramp
text:
We should adopt the 3px solid #005fcc ring with 1px inner #fff at 100% opacity, as it meets the necessary 3:1 contrast ratio on light backgrounds, ensuring legal compliance and inclusivity. This decision prioritizes users who rely on high contrast for navigation, providing them with a clear visual cue. The trade-off is a slightly bolder focus ring that may be more noticeable to sighted users, potentially altering the visual aesthetic. By making this choice, we accept a minor design compromise in favor of enhanced accessibility and reduced legal risk.
[dispatched 3 workers: worker-7697, worker-1977, worker-2207 — done, dissolved]

name: Reader
text: The 100% opacity ring risks visual noise for sighted users in dense interfaces. A 3px solid #005fcc ring with 1px inner #fff at 90% opacity meets WCAG 2.2’s 3:1 contrast on light backgrounds while reducing distraction. Settle it with a live contrast test against the darkest light background in the system.
